title: EST 102 - Principles and Practice of Valuation

items.q: A freehold property produces income in perpetuity and the yield required is 4 per cent. Find the years purchase in perpetuity.
items.s: Year purchase in perpetuity = 1 ÷ rate = 1 ÷ 0.04 = 25.

items.q: A block of flats has a gross rental income of N450000 a year and total outgoings of N200000 a year. Find the net income.
items.s: Net income = gross income − outgoings = N450000 − N200000 = N250000.

items.q: Net income from a shop is N350000 a year and the appropriate years purchase is 8. Find the capital value.
items.s: Capital value = net income × years purchase = N350000 × 8 = N2800000.

items.q: A property is valued at N1750000 and the years purchase applied was 12.5. What net income was capitalised?
items.s: Net income = capital value ÷ years purchase = N1750000 ÷ 12.5 = N140000.

items.q: A property worth N7000000 produces a net income of N350000 a year. Find the yield per cent.
items.s: Yield = (net income ÷ capital value) × 100 = (350000 ÷ 7000000) × 100 = 5 per cent.

items.q: A building costing N15000000 has an expected life of 30 years and a salvage value of N800000. Find the annual depreciation by the straight line method.
items.s: Annual depreciation = (cost − salvage) ÷ life = (N15000000 − N800000) ÷ 30 = N473333.33.

A building of 120 square metres would cost N65000 per square metre to replace and has depreciated by 20 per cent. Find its value by the contractor method.
items.s: Replacement cost = 120 × N65000 = N7800000. Less depreciation of 20 per cent: N7800000 × 0.8 = N6240000.

items.q: A shop of 150 square metres lets for N1800000 a year. Find the rent per square metre per year.
items.s: Rent per square metre = N1800000 ÷ 150 = N12000.

items.s: Gross rent = net income + outgoings = N1150000 + N200000 = N1350000.

Choose the option that correctly defines value in use.
o: the value of the property interest itself rather than the rent from it
a promise in a deed that binds the land
the price a willing buyer would pay a willing seller in an open market
the worth of a property to its present owner for its present purpose
items.s: value in use: the worth of a property to its present owner for its present purpose. The other options describe market value, capital value, covenant.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines managing agent.
o: the exact legal interest being valued, such as freehold or leasehold
a grant of possession of property for a stated term in return for rent
the worth of a property to a particular investor given his requirements
the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner
items.s: managing agent: the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner. The other options describe investment value, interest valued, lease.

items.q: facilities management may be defined as
o: the provision and upkeep of the services that support a building and its users
a right one owner enjoys over the land of another
the written statement of the standard a service must reach
valuing development land as the value of the finished scheme less its cost
items.s: facilities management: the provision and upkeep of the services that support a building and its users. The other options describe easement, residual method, service level agreement.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines term of years.
o: a grant of possession of property for a stated term in return for rent
a lease running for a fixed number of years
valuing property by the cost of replacing it less depreciation
the clause allowing the rent to be reconsidered at stated intervals
items.s: term of years: a lease running for a fixed number of years. The other options describe contractor method, review clause, lease.

items.q: The statement “the interest held by the tenant under a lease” describes which of the following?
o: advance rent
leasehold interest
ground rent
lease
items.s: leasehold interest is the interest held by the tenant under a lease.

items.q: The statement “the date to which a stated valuation applies” describes which of the following?
o: inspection
valuer
date of valuation
basis of valuation
items.s: date of valuation is the date to which a stated valuation applies.

items.q: Which of the following best describes inspection?
o: a lease running for a fixed number of years
the physical examination of the property before it is valued
the professional who estimates and reports property value
the map showing the boundaries and extents of parcels of land
items.s: inspection: the physical examination of the property before it is valued. The other options describe cadastral map, valuer, term of years.

items.q: Which term is described by “a tenancy that renews itself period by period until ended by notice”?
o: rent
ground rent
lease
periodic tenancy
items.s: periodic tenancy is a tenancy that renews itself period by period until ended by notice.

items.q: Which term is described by “the recorded inspection of the physical state of an asset”?
o: condition survey
service level agreement
apportionment of cost
life cycle cost
items.s: condition survey is the recorded inspection of the physical state of an asset.

items.q: Which term is described by “a period in which a property stands empty and earns no rent”?
o: tenancy schedule
managing agent
void period
arrears
items.s: void period is a period in which a property stands empty and earns no rent.

items.q: Which term is described by “the physical examination of the property before it is valued”?
o: basis of valuation
comparables
capital value
inspection
items.s: inspection is the physical examination of the property before it is valued.

items.q: Which of the following best describes reversion?
o: the interest held by the tenant under a lease
the record of every tenant, their term and their rent
a tenancy that renews itself period by period until ended by notice
the interest of the landlord once the lease has ended
items.s: reversion: the interest of the landlord once the lease has ended. The other options describe leasehold interest, tenancy schedule, periodic tenancy.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines review clause?
o: the stated assumption about the market and the interest on which the figure rests
valuing property by capitalising the net income it produces
the clause allowing the rent to be reconsidered at stated intervals
the record of what was seen and decided during an inspection
items.s: review clause: the clause allowing the rent to be reconsidered at stated intervals. The other options describe file note, basis of valuation, investment method.

items.q: The statement “the exact legal interest being valued, such as freehold or leasehold” describes which of the following?
o: rental value
investment value
interest valued
inspection
items.s: interest valued is the exact legal interest being valued, such as freehold or leasehold.

items.q: Which term is described by “rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates”?
o: service charge
rent
reversion
advance rent
items.s: advance rent is rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines interest valued?
o: the exact legal interest being valued, such as freehold or leasehold
valuing property by the profit its business use can support
the worth of a property to its present owner for its present purpose
the provision and upkeep of the services that support a building and its users
items.s: interest valued: the exact legal interest being valued, such as freehold or leasehold. The other options describe value in use, facilities management, profits method.

items.q: arrears may be defined as
o: valuing property by the profit its business use can support
the physical examination of the property before it is valued
a tenancy that renews itself period by period until ended by notice
rent that is due but unpaid
items.s: arrears: rent that is due but unpaid. The other options describe periodic tenancy, inspection, profits method.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines gross income.
o: the income from a property before any deduction
valuing property by the profit its business use can support
rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates
a grant of possession of property for a stated term in return for rent
items.s: gross income: the income from a property before any deduction. The other options describe lease, profits method, advance rent.

items.q: Which of the following best describes planned maintenance?
o: ownership of property for an indefinite period
work scheduled ahead of time rather than waited for after breakdown
the provision and upkeep of the services that support a building and its users
loss of value because the property no longer suits present needs
items.s: planned maintenance: work scheduled ahead of time rather than waited for after breakdown. The other options describe facilities management, freehold interest, obsolescence.

items.q: Which of the following best describes freehold interest?
o: the professional who estimates and reports property value
an interest held for a fixed term under a lease
ownership of property for an indefinite period
valuing property by capitalising the net income it produces
items.s: freehold interest: ownership of property for an indefinite period. The other options describe investment method, valuer, leasehold.

items.q: The statement “the origin from which the facts used in valuation are obtained” describes which of the following?
o: estate record
cadastral map
file note
data source
items.s: data source is the origin from which the facts used in valuation are obtained.

items.q: The statement “valuing property by capitalising the net income it produces” describes which of the following?
o: net income
investment method
residual method
year purchase in perpetuity
items.s: investment method is valuing property by capitalising the net income it produces.

items.q: Which of the following best describes gross income?
o: the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date
the income from a property before any deduction
a lease running for a fixed number of years
the written statement of the standard a service must reach
items.s: gross income: the income from a property before any deduction. The other options describe service level agreement, valuation, term of years.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines residual method?
o: valuing development land as the value of the finished scheme less its cost
valuing property by the cost of replacing it less depreciation
the clause allowing the rent to be reconsidered at stated intervals
a lease running for a fixed number of years
items.s: residual method: valuing development land as the value of the finished scheme less its cost. The other options describe term of years, review clause, contractor method.

items.q: condition survey may be defined as
o: valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties
the stated assumption about the market and the interest on which the figure rests
the consideration paid for the occupation of property
the recorded inspection of the physical state of an asset
items.s: condition survey: the recorded inspection of the physical state of an asset. The other options describe basis of valuation, comparative method, rent.

a promise in a deed that binds the land
the costs an owner bears in keeping a property let, such as repairs and insurance
the rent paid to the owner of the land by the holder of the building lease
items.s: ground rent: the rent paid to the owner of the land by the holder of the building lease. The other options describe covenant, valuer, outgoings.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines valuer?
o: the plan of money set aside for repairs and upkeep
valuing property by the profit its business use can support
the professional who estimates and reports property value
the value of the property interest itself rather than the rent from it
items.s: valuer: the professional who estimates and reports property value. The other options describe profits method, capital value, maintenance budget.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines valuation.
o: the rent a property would fetch if let in the open market
the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date
the written document setting out the figure, its basis and the reasoning
the rate of return used to turn net income into capital value
items.s: valuation: the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date. The other options describe valuation report, capitalisation rate, rental value.

the professional who estimates and reports property value
the plan of money set aside for repairs and upkeep
the map showing the boundaries and extents of parcels of land

the running of property so that it yields its income and keeps its value
the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date
a tenancy that renews itself period by period until ended by notice

items.q: Which of the following best describes valuation report?
o: the rent paid to the owner of the land by the holder of the building lease
the written document setting out the figure, its basis and the reasoning
a lease running for a fixed number of years
rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates
items.s: valuation report: the written document setting out the figure, its basis and the reasoning. The other options describe term of years, ground rent, advance rent.

items.q: Which of the following best describes comparative method?
o: the provision and upkeep of the services that support a building and its users
a grant of possession of property for a stated term in return for rent
the kept information about a property, its tenure and its income
valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties
items.s: comparative method: valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties. The other options describe facilities management, lease, estate record.

items.q: forced sale value may be defined as
o: loss of value because the property no longer suits present needs
the price reached when a sale is made under pressure rather than openly
rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates
the plan of money set aside for repairs and upkeep
items.s: forced sale value: the price reached when a sale is made under pressure rather than openly. The other options describe advance rent, maintenance budget, obsolescence.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines data source?
o: the present value of one naira a year for a stated number of years
the origin from which the facts used in valuation are obtained
the date to which a stated valuation applies
the amount a tenant pays toward the shared costs of the building
items.s: data source: the origin from which the facts used in valuation are obtained. The other options describe date of valuation, service charge, years purchase.

items.q: Which term is described by “valuing development land as the value of the finished scheme less its cost”?
o: residual method
gross income
outgoings
years purchase
items.s: residual method is valuing development land as the value of the finished scheme less its cost.

items.q: Which of the following best describes reactive maintenance?
o: a period in which a property stands empty and earns no rent
the clause allowing the rent to be reconsidered at stated intervals
the kept information about a property, its tenure and its income
work carried out in response to a fault that has occurred

the interest held by the tenant under a lease

items.q: Which term is described by “the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner”?
o: maintenance budget
arrears
void period
managing agent
items.s: managing agent is the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner.

valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties
the price reached when a sale is made under pressure rather than openly

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines outgoings.

an interest held for a fixed term under a lease
the costs an owner bears in keeping a property let, such as repairs and insurance
valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties

items.q: Which statement correctly defines tenancy agreement?
o: the consideration paid for the occupation of property
the division of a shared cost among beneficiaries in proportion to benefit
ownership of property for an indefinite period
the contract setting out the terms between landlord and tenant

items.q: Which term is described by “the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date”?

betterment
depreciation
valuation
items.s: valuation is the estimation of the value of an interest in property at a stated date.

valuing property by reference to the prices of similar properties
the rate of return used to turn net income into capital value

the professional who estimates and reports property value

ground rent
advance rent
review clause
items.s: service charge is the amount a tenant pays toward the shared costs of the building.

items.q: In this course, rent refers to
o: the amount a tenant pays toward the shared costs of the building
the interest held by the tenant under a lease
the consideration paid for the occupation of property
rent paid ahead of the period to which it relates
items.s: rent: the consideration paid for the occupation of property. The other options describe service charge, leasehold interest, advance rent.

items.q: The correct meaning of outgoings is
o: the present value of one naira a year for ever, which is the reciprocal of the rate
valuing property by capitalising the net income it produces
money set aside annually to replace a wasting asset at the end of its life
the costs an owner bears in keeping a property let, such as repairs and insurance
items.s: outgoings: the costs an owner bears in keeping a property let, such as repairs and insurance. The other options describe year purchase in perpetuity, sinking fund, investment method.

rent

periodic tenancy
items.s: lease is a grant of possession of property for a stated term in return for rent.

rent that is due but unpaid
the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner
items.s: managing agent: the person appointed to manage a property on behalf of the owner. The other options describe arrears, void period, maintenance budget.
